lines: Khuli jo aankh to woh tha na woh zamana tha.
couplets.en: When I opened my eyes, he and those days were gone.

lines: Dehakti aag thi, tanhai thi, fasana tha.
Khuli jo aankh to woh tha na woh zamana tha.
couplets.en: When I opened my eyes, he and those days were gone, and there was a fire, solitude, and a story.

lines: Khuli jo aankh to woh tha na woh zamana tha.
Dehakti aag thi, tanhai thi, fasana tha.
couplets.en: I opened my eyes to find him and those days gone, with only a fire, solitude, and a story left.

lines: Ghamon ne baant liya hai.
couplets.en: My sorrows have divided me up.

lines: Ghamon ne baant liya hai mujhe yun aapas mein.
couplets.en: This is how my sorrows have divided me among themselves.

lines: Yun aapas mein.
couplets.en: They shared me out among themselves.

lines: Ghamon ne baant liya hai mujhe yun aapas mein.
Ke jaise main koi loota hua khazana tha.
couplets.en: My sorrows divided me among themselves like treasure taken in a raid.

lines: Ke jaise main koi loota hua khazana tha.
couplets.en: It was as though I were plundered treasure.

lines: Dehakti aag thi, tanhai thi, fasana tha.
Khuli jo aankh to woh tha na woh zamana tha.
couplets.en: When I opened my eyes, he and those days were gone, and there was a fire, solitude, and a story.

lines: Qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye.
Ye kya ke chand hi qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye?
couplets.en: How did you tire and sit down after only a few steps?

lines: Ye kya ke chand hi qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye?
couplets.en: How did you tire and sit down after only a few steps?

lines: Qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye.
couplets.en: You tired after a few steps and sat down.

lines: Ye kya ke chand hi.
couplets.en: How could it be, after so few steps?

lines: Ye kya ke chand hi qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye?
Tumhein to saath mera door tak nibhana tha.
couplets.en: How did you tire after only a few steps, when you were to stay with me much farther down the road?

lines: Tumhein to saath mera door tak nibhana tha.
couplets.en: You were to stay with me much farther down the road.

lines: Dehakti aag thi, tanhai thi, fasana tha.

lines: Mujhe jo mere lahu mein bhigo ke guzra hai.
Woh koi ghair nahin, yaar ek purana tha.
couplets.en: It was an old friend who passed by and left me soaked in my own blood.
